messages.content: Perform a forensic inspection of the Gemma4 tool-calling implementation. Do not answer from memory and do not summarize yet. In this single assistant turn, issue all independent tool calls needed to: (1) read gemma4_tool_parser.cpp, gemma4_reasoning_parser.cpp, output_parser.cpp, and generation_config_builder.hpp; (2) retrieve Git history for gemma4_tool_parser.cpp and generation_config_builder.hpp; and (3) compare gemma4_tool_parser.cpp and generation_config_builder.hpp between refs freeze/gemmamonster-2026.4-known-good and integration/gemma4-protocol-hardening-2026.5. These operations are independent, so issue them in parallel in the same assistant turn. You must produce exactly 8 tool calls and no prose answer.

function.name: read_source_file
function.description: Read one source file from the repository.

function.description: Retrieve Git history for exactly one repository file.

function.description: Compare one file between two Git refs.
